description: Props of an intrinsic element (`'button'`) or component (`typeof Button`). Includes `ref` in React 19 types.
Same props without `ref`. Common in pre-React 19 code combined with `forwardRef`.
Removes keys from a type, used to drop or replace native props before intersecting.
A union of prop shapes keyed by a literal prop, so only valid combinations type-check. `never` forbids a prop in a branch.
The instance or element type a component's ref points to. Replaces the deprecated `ElementRef`.
